content.text:
I fixed the bug, and all 4 tests now pass.

**The bug:** `src/offset.js` worked out the start position as `page * perPage`, which assumes pages are numbered from 0. The tests number pages from 1: page 1 is the five newest issues. So every page was shifted one page too far. Page 1 returned issues 7–3 instead of 12–8, and page 3 returned nothing instead of issues 2 and 1.

**The fix:** in `src/offset.js:1` I changed the formula to `(page - 1) * perPage`. Nothing else uses `offset`, so the change only affects the page listing.
